gate_implementation: TaskClusteredCanaryGate task-to-family aggregation plus exact family-cluster sign test
interpretation: The simulation aggregates correlated tasks within each predeclared family and performs inference across independent family clusters. It covers within-task seed correlation, within-family task correlation, heteroscedasticity, heavy tails, ties, paired shared environment noise, and first/second-order sequence nuisance effects under the exact four-run ABBA/BAAB schedule. Familywise null lineages sample production family-sign units under the exact null. This does not prove real family independence, external-anchor rollback resistance, or AIDE improvement.

null_familywise_calibration.null_model: independent fair family-cluster signs under exact sign-test null

qualification_type: synthetic statistical calibration; not real-task qualification

synthetic_lineage_stress.scope: in-memory budget and family-cluster lineage stress, not RSIStateStore or external-anchor crash qualification
